properties.description: Master orchestration pipeline. Executes all stages sequentially: Ingest → Bronze-to-Silver → Silver-to-Gold. Each stage must succeed before the next begins.

activities.name: Ingest Ecommerce Data
activities.description: Stage 1: Config-driven ingestion from HTTP source to Bronze (Parquet) in ADLS Gen2

activities.name: Transform Bronze to Silver
activities.description: Stage 2: Cleanse, deduplicate, and type-cast Bronze data into Silver (Delta Lake)

activities.name: Transform Silver to Gold
activities.description: Stage 3: Build Star Schema (fact + dimension tables) in Gold layer (Delta Lake)
